name: Zechariah (gatekeeper)
title: Levitical temple guard
summary: Zechariah was one of the Levitical gatekeepers who served at the house of the Lord in David's time, mentioned together with Jaaziel and others in the watch service.

keyEvents.title: Gatekeeper at the temple
keyEvents.description: Zechariah is listed among the Levitical gatekeepers in the temple service.
